program.name: SPP3 Marketplace RFP
program.authority: SPP3 Committee under ENS DAO-approved Marketplace RFP

application.applicantName: Illustrative Applicant — not a real submission

rules.description: Live product or credible go-live path measured in weeks
Primary deliverable is a service to ENS
No active committee conflict under SPP3 standards
Applicant is not a ratified SPP3 cohort provider

eligibility.rationale: Illustrative record only. No real applicant eligibility determination is represented.

evidence.description: Public Marketplace RFP authorization, scope, award structure, evaluation approach, milestones, and committee rules.
Marketplace RFP timeline, eligibility gate, M1–M5 rubric, threshold, payment structure, and committee process.

decision.authority: SPP3 Committee; subsequent ENS executable vote funds selected award
decision.rationale: Illustrative pending record. No real committee judgment is represented.
decision.quorum: Three of four Member seats under the published Marketplace RFP process
decision.decisionRule: Published Marketplace RFP committee process; this illustrative record does not represent a completed committee decision.

challenge.scope: The public Marketplace RFP artifacts reviewed on 2026-08-15 do not specify a post-decision factual or procedural correction process. This field records that gap; it does not infer an appeal right.

deliveryConditions.description: Go-live milestone with objective acceptance criteria.
deliveryConditions.verificationMethod: Independent verification defined in award agreement; stream pauses if go-live is missed without approved revision.
deliveryConditions.consequence: Build stream may pause if required go-live milestone is missed.

deliveryConditions.description: Post-go-live traction gates tied to real marketplace usage.
deliveryConditions.verificationMethod: On-chain or otherwise independently verifiable evidence such as attributed protocol revenue, active paying wallets, completed secondary sales with anti-wash filters, or retention.
dependencies: Final thresholds negotiated using baseline data at award signing.
deliveryConditions.consequence: Unreleased amounts return to the DAO treasury at term end.

redactions.explanation: The live RFP states submissions are stored confidentially during review; this example uses a fictional applicant.

notes: This is a non-evaluative worked example.
It does not identify, score, recommend, or reject any real Marketplace RFP applicant.
The public policy mapping is based on RFP artifacts available as of 2026-08-15.
The missing public correction/challenge path is intentionally represented as processDefined=false so the example exposes rather than conceals the gap.
